A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''hunter''' was the partner of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Komad Fortuna]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. When they attempted to hunt a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the hunter grew impatient and charged into the cave, prompting the dragon to eat him.
